fieldMarks: Sandy-brown above, pinkish-buff belly, pale grey breast
White face with a prominent gorget of black streaking, cream throat
Bold rufous-and-black flank bars (typically eight to ten), red bill and eye-ring, pinkish-red legs
behavior: Prefers running to flying; short flight on rounded wings
Seed eater; chicks rely on insects
Forms flocks outside the breeding season
habitat: Dry lowlands such as farmland and open stony ground; ground nester.
range: Native to France, Iberia and northwest Italy; naturalised in England and Wales. The page read does not describe North American populations.

lookalikes.name: Rock partridge
lookalikes.howToTell: Sharply defined black gorget without streaking below it; greyer back.
